sourceHierarchy: Current rendered Fine Decor .de EN and DE product pages; owner-approved PIM/technical documents remain final authority.
method: Opened the source pages in the in-app Chromium browser, read the active Frosted/Matt gallery, clicked Gloss/Hochglanz, verified its active rendered gallery, and extracted each visible card label with its corresponding data-thumbnail URL. EN/DE label and image URL pairs match in order. Downloaded JPEGs from the observed company-hosted URLs and validated image type, actual dimensions and SHA-256. No legacy table or HTML-only block was imported.
scope: Observed public colour selection only. This is not a complete approved inventory and does not assert stock, delivery, price, dimensions, processing, application compatibility, environmental performance, test ratings or certifications. All imported entries stay source-reference demos and are excluded from fulfilment and public SEO.

exclusions.item: Fine Decor Glaslaminat heading and technical table

identityNotes: No duplicate code + finish relationship occurred in the verified 86 cards, so no variant-ID suffix was needed.
Hyphenated source codes 548-1 and 505-2 remain whole codes in stable IDs.
Six existing demo IDs, manually selected preview colours, material IDs and swatch bytes remain unchanged; all six current source JPEGs are byte-identical to the local originals.
Orthographic weiss/weiß differences for 540 and 191 are recorded in source labels; canonical decor labels use the Frosted spelling.
Colour-family filters are editorial navigation based on visible swatches and names, not measured colour classification.
